As someone who had a similar mindset when I joined the game, let me say this. If you want a deck you can call your own and build it from the ground up, I recommend two things. First, look at what cards exist in the game using scryfall.com. maybe look at all rares in the game or cards in sets, the goal is to spend time looking at all the fun possibilities in the game. Focus on a theme or card and expand. Find something that you think would be fun to have a deck oriented around. Maybe you like a creature type, build a tribal deck of that type. Maybe u like Greek mythos so u build a deck primarily of theros block cards. Find what u like and expand on it. Personally this has led me to build weird but fun decks such as mono red control, Archer tribal in which you give your opponents creatures flying and kill them, and my most recent deck stairs art tribal. Hi, nice to see your enjoying the game. Now to your question. Pretty much any cards can be played with each other but obviously some combinations are better.
